```{python}
import polars as pl
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
import joblib
from pmdarima import auto_arima
from statsmodels.tsa.statespace.sarimax import SARIMAX
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

artifacts_dir = Path("./_artifacts")
memory = joblib.Memory("./_cache", verbose=0)

panel_daily = pl.read_parquet(artifacts_dir / "panel_daily.parquet")
series_index = pl.read_parquet(artifacts_dir / "series_index.parquet")

panel_pd = panel_daily.to_pandas()
series_index_pd = series_index.to_pandas()

def fit_series(args):
    series_id, site_id, product_id = args
    
    series_data = panel_pd[
        (panel_pd["site_id"] == site_id) &
        (panel_pd["product_id"] == product_id)
    ].sort_values("date")
    
    log_y = series_data["log_y"].values
    log_price = series_data["log_price"].values
    
    try:
        auto_model = auto_arima(
            log_y,
            exogenous=log_price.reshape(-1, 1),
            seasonal=True,
            m=7,
            max_p=2,
            max_d=1,
            max_q=2,
            max_P=1,
            max_D=1,
            max_Q=1,
            suppress_warnings=True,
            error_action="ignore",
            stepwise=True
        )
        
        order = auto_model.order
        seasonal_order = auto_model.seasonal_order
        
        sarimax_model = SARIMAX(
            log_y,
            exog=log_price,
            order=order,
            seasonal_order=seasonal_order,
            enforce_stationarity=False,
            enforce_invertibility=False
        )
        
        sarimax_fit = sarimax_model.fit(disp=False, maxiter=200)
        
        beta_price = sarimax_fit.params.get("x1", np.nan)
        
        naive_se = sarimax_fit.bse.get("x1", np.nan)
        
        try:
            robust_result = sarimax_fit.get_robustcov_results(cov_type="HC0")
            robust_se = robust_result.bse.get("x1", np.nan)
        except:
            robust_se = np.nan
        
        aic = sarimax_fit.aic
        bic = sarimax_fit.bic
        converged = sarimax_fit.mle_retvals.get("converged", False)
        
        return {
            "series_id": series_id,
            "site_id": site_id,
            "product_id": product_id,
            "order_p": order[0],
            "order_d": order[1],
            "order_q": order[2],
            "seasonal_P": seasonal_order[0],
            "seasonal_D": seasonal_order[1],
            "seasonal_Q": seasonal_order[2],
            "beta_price": beta_price,
            "naive_se": naive_se,
            "qml_se": robust_se,
            "aic": aic,
            "bic": bic,
            "converged": converged,
            "failed": False
        }
        
    except Exception as e:
        try:
            auto_model = auto_arima(
                log_y,
                exogenous=log_price.reshape(-1, 1),
                seasonal=False,
                max_p=2,
                max_d=1,
                max_q=2,
                suppress_warnings=True,
                error_action="ignore",
                stepwise=True
            )
            
            order = auto_model.order
            
            sarimax_model = SARIMAX(
                log_y,
                exog=log_price,
                order=order,
                seasonal_order=(0, 0, 0, 0),
                enforce_stationarity=False,
                enforce_invertibility=False
            )
            
            sarimax_fit = sarimax_model.fit(disp=False, maxiter=200)
            
            beta_price = sarimax_fit.params.get("x1", np.nan)
            naive_se = sarimax_fit.bse.get("x1", np.nan)
            
            try:
                robust_result = sarimax_fit.get_robustcov_results(cov_type="HC0")
                robust_se = robust_result.bse.get("x1", np.nan)
            except:
                robust_se = np.nan
            
            aic = sarimax_fit.aic
            bic = sarimax_fit.bic
            converged = sarimax_fit.mle_retvals.get("converged", False)
            
            return {
                "series_id": series_id,
                "site_id": site_id,
                "product_id": product_id,
                "order_p": order[0],
                "order_d": order[1],
                "order_q": order[2],
                "seasonal_P": 0,
                "seasonal_D": 0,
                "seasonal_Q": 0,
                "beta_price": beta_price,
                "naive_se": naive_se,
                "qml_se": robust_se,
                "aic": aic,
                "bic": bic,
                "converged": converged,
                "failed": False
            }
        except Exception as e2:
            return {
                "series_id": series_id,
                "site_id": site_id,
                "product_id": product_id,
                "order_p": np.nan,
                "order_d": np.nan,
                "order_q": np.nan,
                "seasonal_P": np.nan,
                "seasonal_D": np.nan,
                "seasonal_Q": np.nan,
                "beta_price": np.nan,
                "naive_se": np.nan,
                "qml_se": np.nan,
                "aic": np.nan,
                "bic": np.nan,
                "converged": False,
                "failed": True
            }

series_args = [
    (row["series_id"], row["site_id"], row["product_id"])
    for _, row in series_index_pd.iterrows()
]

results = joblib.Parallel(n_jobs=-1, verbose=1)(
    joblib.delayed(fit_series)(args) for args in series_args
)

fit_results = pd.DataFrame(results)
fit_results = pl.from_pandas(fit_results)

fit_failures = fit_results.filter(pl.col("failed") == True)
fit_results = fit_results.filter(pl.col("failed") == False)

fit_results.write_parquet(artifacts_dir / "fit_results.parquet")
fit_failures.write_parquet(artifacts_dir / "fit_failures.parquet")
```
